# hpe_morpheus_load_balancer (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hpe_morpheus_load_balancer" "example" {
  id = 99
}
```

```terraform
data "hpe_morpheus_load_balancer" "example" {
  name = "Example load balancer"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) The ID of the load balancer
- `name` (String) The name of the load balancer

### Read-Only

- `admin_port` (String) The admin port of the load balancer
- `allow_vip_entry` (Boolean) Whether VIP entry is allowed
- `api_port` (String) The API port of the load balancer
- `cloud` (Attributes) The cloud associated with the load balancer (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--cloud))
- `config` (Attributes) The configuration of the load balancer (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--config))
- `credential` (Attributes) The credential associated with the load balancer (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--credential))
- `date_created` (String) The date the load balancer was created
- `description` (String) The description of the load balancer
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the load balancer is enabled
- `external_id` (String) The external ID of the load balancer
- `external_ip` (String) The external IP address of the load balancer
- `host` (String) The hostname of the load balancer
- `instance_price` (Attributes) The instance price of the load balancer (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--instance_price))
- `internal_ip` (String) The internal IP address of the load balancer

- `last_updated` (String) The date the load balancer was last updated
- `owner` (Attributes) The owner of the load balancer (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--owner))

- `password_hash` (String) The hashed password for the load balancer
- `permissions` (Attributes) The resource permissions of the load balancer (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--permissions))
- `pool_name` (String) The pool name of the load balancer
- `port` (Number) The port of the load balancer
- `server_name` (String) The server name of the load balancer
- `ssl_cert` (String) The SSL certificate of the load balancer
- `ssl_enabled` (Boolean) Whether SSL is enabled on the load balancer
- `tenant_id` (Number) The ID of the tenant the load balancer belongs to
- `tenants` (Attributes Set) The tenants associated with the load balancer (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tenants))
- `type` (Attributes) The type of load balancer (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--type))
